abliterated-model.reason: abliteration.ai's refusal-removed (abliterated) derivative of an open-weight base; abliteration edits the model's weights to remove refusal behavior, making it a fine-tune-style derivative the catalog does not model.

abliterated-model-large.reason: Abliteration.ai's own blog says it was built from Zhipu's GLM-5.2 and then abliterated and fine-tuned; a weight-edited derivative is not zhipu/glm-5.2 itself.

abliterated-model-large-flash.reason: Infron and Unlid describe it as an uncensored derivative of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 with refusal behavior removed in the weights — a weight-modified fine-tune, not the base checkpoint.

abliterated-model-large-v2.reason: Abliteration.ai built it from Zhipu's GLM-5.3 and then abliterated and fine-tuned it (per the vendor's documentation and multiple listings); a weight-edited derivative is not zhipu/glm-5.3 itself.
